classification: preregistered alternative defensive-asset follow-up to R324; identical portfolio gates and no A/B parameter search
question: R324 的国债逆波动配置把收益压到接近现金。保留同一冻结 R312 权益复合袖、同一 60 日逆波动规则和同一组门槛，改用与权益低相关的黄金 ETF 作为防御袖，能否在控制 MDD 的同时修复 2022/2023、随机一年、滚动一年和收益能力？
sequence_note: R325 is a sequential follow-up after R324 failed. Gold is a pre-existing crisis-diversifier hypothesis, not chosen by scanning ETF returns. Results remain subject to multiple-testing and regime limitations.

data.equity_composite: R312 A/B 60d inverse-vol risk parity, A bounds [0.2,0.8], then 15% vol target [0.2,1.0], frozen

portfolio_rule.rebalance: monthly, first common trading day; target uses returns strictly before that day
portfolio_rule.asset_weights: inverse-volatility between the frozen R312 equity composite and the selected gold ETF
portfolio_rule.volatility_estimate: trailing 60-day covariance using the inverse-vol asset weights
portfolio_rule.warmup: first 60 aligned returns use equity weight 0.5 and gross exposure 0.5
portfolio_rule.leverage: not allowed; equity and gold weights are nonnegative and their sum is <= 1.0
portfolio_rule.cost_application: round-trip cost times one-way portfolio turnover including cash movement

variants.primary_gold: frozen R312 composite + 518880.SH under the portfolio_rule
variants.robustness_gold: same rule with 159937.SZ instead of 518880.SH; robustness check only, not selected on performance

gates.D1_data: both gold ETF series cover >=95% of aligned R312 dates; no duplicate dates, null close, or nonpositive close
gates.G4_calendar_stability: primary calendar 2022 return >=0 and calendar 2023 return >=0
gates.G5_bootstrap: 20-day circular block bootstrap, 1000 paths, 252 days: positive rate >=80% and return P5 >= -12%
gates.G6_rolling_year: actual rolling 252-day positive rate >=70% and worst rolling 252-day return >= -15%
gates.G8_stress: 3x allocator round-trip cost full-path return >0 and MDD >= -25%
gates.G9_incremental: versus frozen R312 on the same dates: Sharpe improves by >=0.05 or MDD improves by >=3pp; annual return is no worse than R312 minus 1.0pp
gates.G10_no_leverage: every monthly equity and gold weight is >=0 and their sum is <=1.0
gates.R1_robustness: second gold ETF variant has calendar 2022 and 2023 each >=0 and MDD >= -20%

selection_rule: D1 + G1-G10 + R1 all pass -> R325 becomes candidate_for_concentration_audit only. Any failure -> selected=null, retain R312 holding-profile caveat, and record negative knowledge. No weight, window, target-vol, ETF or gate changes after seeing results.

bootstrap.method: circular 20-trading-day block bootstrap from the primary daily return sequence

known_limitations: Gold ETF qfq prices are provider-adjusted and are not an official point-in-time archive.
The 2021-2026 sample contains a strong gold bull market; a pass cannot be extrapolated as a permanent gold premium.
R325 is a sequential follow-up after R324 and has multiple-testing risk.
The equity composite uses R40 local research data, current industry snapshots and current factor versions.
A pass is only a candidate for a separate concentration, liquidity and paper-execution audit.
